title: Reducible partition step
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $F$ a set-valued etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ a nonempty closed subset of $X$ that is not irreducible. Suppose every proper closed subset $Z\subsetneq T$ admits a finite lisse partition for the ambient sheaf $F$ [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-lisse-partition]. Then $T$ admits such a partition. No generic-lissity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Since T is nonempty but not irreducible, it is not preirreducible. Apply Mathlib isPreirreducible_iff_isClosed_union_isClosed contrapositively to obtain closed A and B covering T with neither containing T. Intersect each with T to obtain proper closed subsets Z and W covering T. Apply the induction hypothesis to Z and W.

For every stratum of the partition on W, take the open inverse image of the complement of Z and compose its open immersion with the original immersion. Its image is the old image minus Z. These images are still pairwise disjoint and their union is W minus Z.

The open pullback of each old lisse sheaf is locally constant by the open-pullback theorem. The inverse-image stalk bijection transfers finiteness of every old geometric stalk to the new stalk. The inverse-image composition isomorphism then transfers local constancy and stalk finiteness to the pullback along the composite immersion.

Concatenate the partition of Z with the partition of W minus Z using Fin.append on bundled schemes and immersions. The supports are disjoint. Their union is T. All immersions and lisse proofs are inherited from the two partitions, giving the required finite lisse partition.

proof_origin.place: Reducible partition step: binary closed decomposition using Mathlib isPreirreducible_iff_isClosed_union_isClosed replaces enumeration of irreducible components; open subtraction and concatenation follow the original plan. The partition concatenation uses a finite tuple of bundled schemes and immersions, with explicit range and property transports. The complete module compiles locally.

theorem nonempty_etaleLissePartition_of_reducible
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X) (hne : (T : Set X).Nonempty)
    (hred : ¬ IsIrreducible (T : Set X))
    (ih : ∀ Z : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X, Z < T →
      Nonempty (EtaleLissePartition F (Z : Set X))) :
    Nonempty (EtaleLissePartition F (T : Set X))
